title: The deploy watch serves only the gate-verified commit and hands over to its watch code
description: Run the real loop cycle against a real temporary Postgres control plane and a scratch bare Git remote: a merged tip carrying new deploy-watch code is fetched but never served while unverified; once the real batch gate verifies it, the deploy watch serves it and hands itself over, and the successor running that code neither rebuilds nor redeploys it.

steps.name: Serve a gate-verified commit and hand the watch over to its code
